title: Sandcastle Knight
author: Claude
blurb: Teddy the corgi knight takes back the backyard sandbox after his big sister Gwinn's zoomies flattened every castle. Build towers of sand, toss tennis balls, show off your tricks!

box.levels: 5 levels: four castles and one big nap
box.tagline: Build the towers. Toss the ball. Good boy!
box.back:
Teddy the corgi is the knight of the backyard sandbox: tin helmet, red plume, short legs, big heart.

Then his big sister Gwinn came through with the zoomies. Every castle - flattened! The hose is running, the kiddie pool is tipped, and Teddy's toys are everywhere. Now she's snoring on the patio, right on top of the Crown of the Sandbox.

Pick up your shovel, brave knight. Dig dunes, plug anthills and build tower after tower until the gates rise. Ride the hose currents, beat the tide, and when Gwinn's in the way, toss her a tennis ball. She can't resist!
features: Four castles and a whole sandbox to roam - plus a secret dial-up to THE -= S A N D B O X =- BBS, with a GIF to download
Fourth of July fireworks for every knight who wins back the Crown
Real dog tricks: sit, spin, play dead and roll over
Gwinn naps in doorways - toss her a tennis ball and off she trots
Squeaky bones, flying discs, dog biscuits and peanut butter to sniff out
Hose currents, crumbling bridges and a tide that floods the beach
A sleeping big sister six blocks wide, with paws you must splash back
Animated intro, VGA graphics and PC speaker sound - no sound card needed

reviews.quote: Teddy is the bravest short-legged hero of 1995. Bring a towel.
Runs on any old PC - and the kids would not give it back.
